clues: This town is in south-east Australia. It sits by a lake near the Snowy Mountains.
Snow falls here a lot each winter. It comes back year after year, not just once.
The town was moved to this spot in the 1960s. Its old land now lies under a lake made by a dam.
Few towns of its size sit so high in this land. It is one of the highest towns you can find here.
Ski fans know this town by the big ski parks near it. Thredbo and Perisher are two of those close ski spots.
